newsitem.title: SPAIN: BCH says may have future joint activity with Banco de Colombia.
newsitem.headline: BCH says may have future joint activity with Banco de Colombia.

text.p: Spain's Banco Central Hispano said it did not rule out future joint activities with the Banco de Colombia, BCH sources told Reuters.
"We do not rule out the development of joint activities," a bank source told Reuters.
Earlier, Banco de Colombia SA's majority shareholders, Isaac and Jaime Gilinski, said they and BCH had jointly decided to end their discussions to form a strategic partnership.
Industry sources said the rupture stemmed from differences over the size of partners' stakes in the management of the bank.
